title: Receipted write-ahead commits inside a caller's open transaction when begun from start_next_queued_turn_locked
outcome: Receipted write-ahead commits inside a caller's open transaction when begun from start_next_queued_turn_locked
acceptance: A receipted head's write-ahead hand-off record begun by a drain inside another operation's transaction (for example the Stop path's dispatch_queued_prompts_on_success) is committed and its fence requested only after that operation's own durable commit, so the operation's rollback on a failed commit still covers it; a test shows the order
prompt_delivery_gate_locked reads the record without taking session_mut_by_index (no mutation stamp) when it only waits or refuses
